observations.detail: Original canonical 804x410 PNG was opened first. A source-only nearest-neighbor dial crop was opened second. The independent inventory was written before candidate objects/assertions were read. Battery, polarity, coaxial coils, support, open knife switch, separate primary/secondary wiring, galvanometer mechanism/terminals, needle, labels and every scale mark were inventoried.

Source dial has 11 radial marks: two endpoints, central zero and four intermediate marks on each side. Candidate pixels and candidate spec have nine: two endpoints, central zero and three intermediate marks on each side. The candidate removes one subdivision on each side while retaining endpoint labels 5 and central 0.

The primary and smaller secondary share one vertical coil assembly. The secondary over-winding is not a detached side-by-side coil. Insulating end flanges, a support with two fittings, an open knife switch, DC source and galvanometer remain identifiable. Turn and support-hatch counts are explicitly schematic and unquantified rather than false source-given values. The battery uses a modern source symbol without claiming an additional source cell count.

Battery negative goes to one primary end; positive goes to the switch pivot, and the other switch contact returns to the other primary end. The visible blade/contact gap remains open. Two secondary leads run separately to separate galvanometer terminals, without joining the primary DC circuit. Independent external-wire intersection calculation finds no cross-circuit crossings; actual pixels show no false external junction. Thin muted label leaders and hidden-core contours remain distinguishable from electrical wires.

The meter needle remains at central zero, without a measured nonzero throw. No current/flux/insertion direction, mu multiplier, quantitative result, filled answer or solved comparison is drawn. Candidate needle is a straight pointer rather than the source's pointed silhouette; zero alignment and instructional meaning remain clear. No node, wire endpoint or pointer is clipped at 640 or 316 px.

The visible removable iron-core rod, its axial position and English identification are explicitly declared in the spec's modern-addition inventory group. They agree with the complete frozen bilingual prose and are not treated as visible original-source facts. The hidden continuation is muted/dashed and no motion arrow or experiment outcome is added.

All 14 labels use English apparatus names or permitted signs/numerals. At the exact 316px media transform the minimum screen font size is 16.7875px; at 640px/native 640x1000 it is 34px. Both opened images are readable. Independent browser text boxes have no overlaps or clipping; visible shape boxes are inside the media. No Cyrillic/Chinese text or historical-cultural marks appear in the output.
The isolated browser captures are opaque, nonblank and visually intact: 48,857 non-paper pixels at 640x1000 and 14,617 at 316x494. Neither image is black or broken.
Only the unchanged SVG at exact media widths was independently inspected. This is not a whole-card, headed product, lesson-edition, offline-card, scroll or DB publication approval.

findings.title: Two original galvanometer subdivisions are omitted

sourceEvidence.structure: 5 endpoint - four intermediate ticks - central 0 - four intermediate ticks - 5 endpoint; endpoint numerals are unsigned.

candidateEvidence.structure: 5 endpoint - three intermediate ticks - central 0 - three intermediate ticks - 5 endpoint.

findings.impact: The dial's marked subdivisions differ from the original instructional scale. Native connects assertions validate the nine supplied segments but do not validate their source count. A render PASS therefore cannot establish source fidelity.
findings.disposition: Blocking independent figure approval. The author already used the sole permitted repair; no additional repair or rerender was attempted or authorized in this review.
